Hello everyone,

I upload a series of files in shiny by

  UI:  fileInput("files", "Choose CSV processed files", multiple = "TRUE",accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv','.cel'))

Now i want to get the name of files uploaded. Say i have uploaded three CSV or TXT files with name 1,2,3 . Then how to get the name of files(1.csv,2.csv,3.csv and so on) uploaded.

 Help highly appreciated. Thanks
